answer: Give each identity a reward ceiling that rises only with the age of its graded track record, and never let reputation be transferred or merged. A newcomer starts as a faint ember earning a sliver; a long run of peer-verified answers slowly hardens into crystal-clear standing with a higher cap. Splitting into a nebula of fresh accounts gains nothing, because every clone restarts at the floor, so patient honest work out-earns a swarm of fakes.
